Class PriceQuote

java.lang.Object
com.eqixiac.equinix.design.value.ratecard.PriceQuote
public class PriceQuote extends Object
An immutable price for a single resource, split into its monthly-recurring (MRC) and non-recurring (one-time setup, NRC) components, tagged with the PriceSource it was resolved from.

All monetary values use BigDecimal to avoid floating-point drift, consistent with the rest of the SDK's billing models. Quotes are additive via plus(PriceQuote) so an engine can aggregate per-resource quotes into a deployment total while preserving provenance.

      public static PriceQuote zero(Currency currency, PriceSource source)

    • totalOverTerm

      public BigDecimal totalOverTerm(Term term)
      The total cost over a commitment term: MRC × term.months() + NRC. This is the figure the TCO comparison ranks archetypes by, so one-time setup charges are never ignored in a recommendation.
      Parameters:
      term - the commitment term
      Returns:
      the full-term cost including the one-time setup charge

    • plus

      public PriceQuote plus(PriceQuote other)
      Sums this quote with another. Both must share the same currency — this class never fabricates an FX conversion. The resulting source is preserved when both quotes agree, otherwise it is reported as PriceSource.COMPOSITE. The per-quote notes are dropped on aggregation (a merged note would misattribute provenance); callers that need them must read the operands. A null argument returns this quote unchanged.
      Parameters:
      other - the quote to add (may be null)
      Returns:
      a new aggregated quote without a note
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the currencies differ
